name: Jordan
label: Mourns removed features, bloat
who: I'm on Premium individual and I use Spotify on desktop and phone. I like features like crossfade and shuffle options, and I get annoyed when features are removed or hidden.
value_for_money: Mixed and frustrated. One user says they still do not have a setting after years of paying, even after prices went up. Another says the app is convenient enough that they would keep the subscription, and a third says the app used to have a simple UI with few ads, but ads have increased.
loyalty: Stays because parts of the app are convenient and because some features are worth it. Would leave if removed features are not restored or if the app keeps getting bloated and full of ads.
pain_points: Features get removed or hidden without explanation
Features appear and then disappear again
App feels bloated with new design choices
likes: Spicetify for customizing the desktop app
reasons_to_stay: They keep the subscription because the app is convenient and they like features like crossfade. They also value customizing the desktop app with Spicetify, which they say is worth the effort even though they dislike many of the official changes.
tone: Blunt and sarcastic, often swearing and comparing the app to older versions.
